g.text: Descriptor kinds (one YAML file per artifact)
Relation enum (drg/models.py): requires, suggests, applies, scope,
enhances, overrides, refines, in_tension_with, reconciles_tension, rejects.
vocabulary targets glossary and term (ADR-0049 d4).
A step enhancement is a file, not the enhances relation (ADR-0050 d22).
Solid diamond = file containment; dashed = id/URN reference.
Yellow «pending» / [pending …]: decided in the cited ADR,
but the cited open question is not ruled.
